text:
oliver: Quick sync — need to lock Q3 perf scope. Acme is pushing for p99 <= 120ms on chat-serving (8k window) for Dedicated proof-of-concept. They said contract hinges on it. Any realistic path?
maya: 120ms at 8k is aggressive. We can get there with KV hot-prefix + aggressive batching + int8 kernels, but quality/regressions risk increases.
li: agree with maya. Our KV prototype shows ~20–30% p99 improvement for prefix-heavy workloads. numbers from last run: 

```
model: redwood-v1-13b
hw: a100-80gb
seq: 8192
baseline_p99: 160ms
kv_prefetch_p99: 125ms
kv+int8_p99_est: ~110ms (estimate, needs full eval)
```

li: caveat: int8 path currently has edge-case hallucination uptick on our eval suite. need regression gates.
james: okay, what's minimum viable launch criteria? we should be explicit for sales + SRE.
sara: propose launch checklist: 
- p99 <= 130ms on Acme canonical trace (must document trace)
- quality regressions < 0.5% RRT on core prompts (automated eval)
- canary traffic plan with automatic fallback to fp16 model if regressions detected
- end-to-end tests in Dedicated staging with production scale tokens

sara: if we can guarantee the above, sales can take the commitment and we can ship initial Dedicated pilot.
maya: to hit those metrics we need scope:
- land KV slot eviction + prefix prefetch (eng runtime)
- add int8 kernel(opt) + calibration harness (eng-ml)
- build regression eval dashboard + per-prompt alerting (console)
- canary rollout + fallback policy (platform/sre)

maya: estimate dev time: KV work 3 wks, int8 kernel 4–6 wks (parallel), eval dashboard 2 wks, canary infra 1 wk. With parallel work, 6–8 weeks total.
li: risk list: data quality for quantization, memory pressure with KV during heavy bursts, scheduling interactions when batching + cache both active. Need microbenchmarks for each.
james: proposal for prioritization: make KV + regression gates top priority for Q3 sprint 1, int8 in sprint 2 with strict eval gating. That lowers immediate risk.

oliver: sounds reasonable. Sales wants a date they can quote — can we commit to having a pilot by end of sprint 3 (8 weeks)?
maya: yes if we get one cross-team week of dedicated focus and no major infra blockers. Otherwise add 2 weeks buffer.
sara: I'll tell Acme we can aim for late Q3 pilot; provide weekly progress updates and the gating criteria above.

li: infra ask: need A/B queueing so we can split kernels without impacting other tenants. tagging @deploy-bot to schedule a short infra window.
deploy-bot: Deploy window requested: runtime-kv-stage, 2026-07-14 02:00 UTC — awaiting approvals.

james: next steps:
- maya & li: write short tech spec by EOD Friday (include perf targets + regression plan)
- sara: update sales SLA language to reflect gating and fallback
- oliver: coordinate stakeholder sync Mon AM with Acme

oliver: thanks — add any blockers here and we'll triage in Monday sync.
